in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Vishnu's child
in_marathi.long_meaning: Balachandra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Balachandra is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Bala’ meaning ‘child’ and ‘Chandra’ meaning ‘Moon’. This name is a reverence to Lord Vishnu, signifying that the child is a manifestation or divine embodiment of the god.
